bapc-prelims-2009.notes: Source 1 is a six-PDF crawl of the 2009 archive directory, of which only the dkp pair (sources 2 and 3, identical to the copies held there) belongs to this contest; the bapc and nwerc PDFs are of other contests. The solutions slides are dated 2008-10-03 on the title slide, which looks like a slip for 2009; the PDF's own metadata says October 2009.

sources.evidence: The copy is six PDFs from the 2009 archive directory (preliminaries, final and NWERC problem sets and solutions) and has no html page.
18-page PDF headed BAPC 2009 Preliminaries with statements A to I from All-Out Arctic Warfare to Typechecker.
30-page beamer slide PDF titled BAPC 2009 Preliminary Rounds, The Solutions, with slides for problems A to I.

bapc-prelims-2010.notes: Source 1 and 2 are the BAPC 2010 finals website (2010.bapc.eu, finals on 23 October 2010); source 1 also holds the 2010 preliminaries PDFs. Source 2 differs from the earlier reading because our copy has been replaced (the earlier reader saw a different page). Source 4's linked problem pages are not in our copy; claim that they are 'not in our copy' rests on the single saved page.

sources.evidence: The copy holds the 2010.bapc.eu website of the BAPC finals on 23 October 2010 plus 2010 PDFs from the CHipCie archive; the site's schedule and news are about the finals, not the preliminaries.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader took the page for a Dutch news page of De Leidsche Flesch without BAPC content; our copy is the home page of the BAPC 2010 website, of the finals.
sources.evidence: Home page headed BAPC 2010 - Leiden with news saying BAPC takes place in Leiden on 23 October 2010, which is the finals, not the preliminaries of 2 October.
24-page PDF headed Preliminaries 2 October 2010 listing Problems A to J, Evolution to My Cousin Obama, each with an example.
Baekjoon category page titled BAPC 2010 Preliminaries with a table of 10 problems A to J.

bapc-prelims-2011.notes: Source 1 is the BAPC 2011 main-contest site (Eindhoven, 15 Oct 2011), not a preliminaries-only site; it mentions the preliminaries in news. Earlier reader saw a 2014 copy (same_copy null). Judge whether it belongs here.

sources.disagreement: The earlier reader saw a copy of bapc.eu showing BAPC 2014 and concluded wrong-contest; our current copy is the 2011 edition of the site, which covers the 2011 preliminaries in its news.
sources.evidence: The seed page is titled 'Benelux Algorithm Programming Contest 2011 - Eindhoven' and its news items announce the preliminaries' problem set and final standings, though the site is mainly that of the main contest of 15 October 2011.

Baekjoon category page titled 'BAPC 2011 Preliminaries' with a table of ten problems A to J.

bapc-prelims-2013.notes: Source 2's pack roles say standings; verdict correct to problemset (it is a contest summary page with no standings). Eolymp date 2013-12-02 is the judge's own session, not the contest day.

sources.evidence: Eolymp contest page 'The 2013 Benelux Algorithm Programming Contest, BAPC 2013, Preliminary' lists 11 problems and a sign-in wall, with no standings table.
Cover reads 'Preliminaries for the 2013 Benelux Algorithm Programming Contest' and lists problems A to K.
